$comment: What the importer should make of ecs-rds/main.tf. evidence: 'definite' = every input comes from the plan or an AWS default and every line used is definite; 'assumption' = an input is an estimate or a presumed/candidate line. Numbers: db.t3.medium has 4 GiB; PostgreSQL max_connections = LEAST(memory/9531392, 5000) = 450 with all memory, 414 after the 8% OS reserve. The pool per task is not in Terraform, so it is an estimate (10). In the plan, health_check and multi_az are unknown until apply (after_unknown), so the importer fills the AWS defaults (evidence aws-default, still definite). ids: the resource type without aws_ plus _name (decisions.md, M22). params are what the design gets; facts are values the design has no field for, kept for the checks. concurrency, serviceMs, connections, readMs and writeMs are estimates from the instance table (M23; 0.5 vCPU task, 2 vCPU db.t3.medium).
